subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction plugins receive a current-session deferred reset capability, with raw lifecycle queue authority reserved for the authenticated built-in OpenClaw, bundled Codex, and bundled Copilot harnesses?
rationale: This permanently expands the plugin hook contract and grants selected harnesses privileged session-reset authority; tests can verify implementation mechanics but cannot choose the repository's intended capability boundary.

options.title: Approve the scoped contract
options.body: Approve current-session-only deferred resets for successful, unlocked after-compaction hooks after removing the schema shim, documenting the API, and adding exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep resets internal
options.body: Withhold resetSession from plugin hooks and implement compaction recovery entirely within the owning embedded or harness lifecycle.

options.title: Pause and split the work
options.body: Separate the hook API, loop-detection behavior, and database compatibility changes so each policy decision can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped contract
recommendation.body: Approve current-session-only deferred resets for successful, unlocked after-compaction hooks after removing the schema shim, documenting the API, and adding exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest available decision trail is the recent session-database compatibility ruling and adjacent ownership of reset lifecycle behavior.
